identities.summary: Living Yuuzhan Vong weapon with quarterstaff, poisoned spear, reach/Pin/Trip whip, and once-per-day venom-spit forms.
identities.canonicalPlayerText: An amphistaff is a serpentine creature genetically engineered by the Yuuzhan Vong to serve as a weapon. It has three weapon forms: quarterstaff, spear, or whip; switching forms is a swift action. In quarterstaff form it has all the qualities of a quarterstaff. In spear form it can be wielded or thrown as a spear; if the target takes damage and the attack roll equals or exceeds its Fortitude Defense, the target moves -1 persistent step on the condition track. In whip form it has reach 2 squares; its tail deals 1d4 piercing damage plus the wielder's Strength modifier and uses the same poison condition-track effect. Instead of dealing whip damage, a proficient wielder can use it to pin or trip as though using the Pin or Trip feat without needing that feat. In any form, the wielder can coax it to spit venom up to 10 squares as a standard action; if the attack hits both Reflex and Fortitude Defense, the target moves -1 persistent step on the condition track. It can spit venom only once every 24 standard hours.
